title: session-handoff-deadline-protocol: shadow-to-canary handover with replay-safe drain
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: Several customer incidents showed user sessions getting inconsistent results during shadow -> canary transitions when per-session stickiness and long-lived KV cache entries existed. This PR introduces a session handoff protocol with an explicit deadline and replay-safe drain to ensure session-consistency during shadow-to-canary transitions, plus observable probes and operator controls. Summary of changes: - Add SessionHandoffCoordinator service that tracks per-session phase (shadow, pending-handoff, active-canary) and enforces a configurable deadline for handoff. - Implement graceful deadline semantics: when the deadline expires, active user requests are allowed to complete on the origin model; subsequent requests are routed to the canary, and any in-flight KV cache entries are checkpointed for safe replay. - Introduce per-session tokens for stickiness that are transparently reissued during the handoff window to avoid split-brain routing on retries. - Add replay-safe drain helpers for runtimes that manage KV caches and streaming sessions (hooks for cuda/kv cache flush). - Console: new handoff dashboard with per-rollout countdown, stalled-session list, and operator-triggered immediate-cutover button. - E2E: extended the rollout integration harness to simulate long-lived sessions and network flaps. - Tests: unit tests for coordinator state machine, integration tests for token reissuance and deadline behavior, and load-scenario validation in perf canary harness. Backwards compatibility: defaults keep current behavior (no session handoff) unless a rollout specifies "handoff_deadline_ms" or uses the new "session_handoff" flag. Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-1724) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Console UX mockups - [x] Perf validation in canary lab Known limitations: - On extremely high churn of short sessions, additional token issuance load was observed in perf tests; we added rate-limiting but further optimization may be follow-up (ENG-1789). - On on-prem installs with very old runtimes, the replay hooks are no-op; installer will surface a warning. Related work: builds on the traffic-anchoring and shadow drain utilities (see ENG-1629 and PRs that added per-cohort anchoring).

release_notes: Add optional session handoff protocol for rollout transitions: configurable deadline, replay-safe drain hooks, console handoff dashboard, and operator controls. Off by default; enable via session_handoff in rollout spec.
